local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local RangedCombatClient = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("RangedCombatClient"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local CharacterValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CharacterValue
local featureSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版移动端射击视角")
local bow = script.Parent
local FirePoint = bow.Handle.FirePoint
local c_reloadTime = bow:FindFirstChild("配置"):FindFirstChild("装填时长")
local atkTrack:AnimationTrack?
local active = false

local function fireArrow(startPos:Vector3,endPos:Vector3,shotToken:number?)
	local isLocalPlayer = bow.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character
	bow:WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("Fire"):Play()
	local arrow = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("毒箭"):Clone()
	arrow.Position = startPos
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	arrow.Transparency = 1
	RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	arrow.Anchored = false
	game.Debris:AddItem(arrow,5)
	local delta = endPos - startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 then arrow:Destroy() return end
	arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = delta.Unit * 500
	local lastPos = arrow.Position
	while arrow and arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		if lastPos ~= arrow.Position then
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
			params:AddToFilter(arrow)
			local offset = arrow.Position - lastPos
			local hitResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset,params)
			if hitResult then
				local hit = hitResult.Instance
				if isLocalPlayer and GameHelper:IsNPC(hit) then
					bow.ArrowHitC2S:FireServer(hit,shotToken)
				end
				arrow:WaitForChild("Trail").Enabled = false
				local dir = arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.001 and arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit or offset.Unit
				arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position,hitResult.Position+dir)
				arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)
				break
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
		end
		RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	end
end

local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or bow:GetAttribute("Reload") or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		shotContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
		if not shotContext then return end
	end
	local endPos = shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
	bow:SetAttribute("Reload",true)
	bow.Arrow.Transparency = 1
	local reloadBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.bowReloadBonus)
	local reloadTime = GameHelper:CalculateCDDiminishing(c_reloadTime.Value,reloadBonus)
	task.delay(reloadTime,function()
		if bow.Parent then
			bow:SetAttribute("Reload",false)
			bow.Arrow.Transparency = 0
		end
	end)
	task.wait(0.1)
	if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local startPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
	bow.Attack:FireServer(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
	fireArrow(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)

	local doubleArrowBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.doubleArrowBonus)
	if math.random() <= doubleArrowBonus then
		if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
		task.delay(0.1,function()
			if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			local secondContext
			if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
				secondContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
				if not secondContext then return end
			end
			local secondEndPos = secondContext and secondContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
			local secondStartPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
			bow.Attack:FireServer(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
			fireArrow(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
		end)
	end
end

local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(bow)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(bow,shoot)
	end
end

bow:SetAttribute("Reload",false)
bow.Equipped:Connect(function()
	if bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	active = true
	atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character,109073254954663)
	atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
	atkTrack.Looped = false
	RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(bow)
	bindNewInput()
end)
bow.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	active = false
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(bow)
	if atkTrack then atkTrack:Destroy() atkTrack = nil end
end)
bow.Activated:Connect(function()
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then return end
	shoot(nil)
end)
featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(bindNewInput)
UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(bindNewInput)

bow.Attack.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(startPos:Vector3,endPos:Vector3)
	if bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then fireArrow(startPos,endPos) end
end)

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))

local bow = script.Parent
local c_damage = bow:FindFirstChild("配置"):FindFirstChild("伤害")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local lastAttackAt = {}
local pendingShots = {}

local function validEquipped(player)
	return player.Character ~= nil and bow.Parent == player.Character and GameHelper:isAlive(player)
end
local function validVector(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
end
local function validToken(token)
	return type(token) == "number" and token % 1 == 0 and token >= 1 and token <= 2147483647
end
local function simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	local delta=endPos-startPos
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(startPos,delta.Unit*math.min(delta.Magnitude,1100),params)
	pendingShots[player]=pendingShots[player] or {}
	pendingShots[player][shotToken]={
		hit=result and result.Instance or nil,
		position=result and result.Position or nil,
		expires=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3,
		consumed=false,
	}
end

bow.Attack.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not validVector(startPos) or not validVector(endPos) then return end
	local firePoint = bow:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	if not firePoint or not firePoint:IsA("Attachment") or (startPos-firePoint.WorldPosition).Magnitude > 5 then return end
	local delta = endPos-startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 or delta.Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local previous=lastAttackAt[player] or 0
	if now-previous < 0.075 then return end
	lastAttackAt[player]=now
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local shots=pendingShots[player]
		local previousShot=shots and shots[shotToken]
		if previousShot and now<=previousShot.expires then return end
		simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	end
	bow.Attack:FireAllClients(startPos,endPos)
end)

bow.ArrowHitC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,hitPart,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not hitPart or not hitPart:IsA("BasePart") or not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	local authoritativeHit=hitPart
	local hitPosition=hitPart.Position
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local record=pendingShots[player] and pendingShots[player][shotToken]
		if not record or record.consumed or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>record.expires then return end
		record.consumed=true
		authoritativeHit=record.hit
		hitPosition=record.position
		if not authoritativeHit or not hitPosition then return end
		local _,clientNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hitPart)
		local _,serverNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
		if not clientNpc or clientNpc~=serverNpc then return end
	end
	local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (hitPosition-root.Position).Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
	if not isNpc or not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then return end
	local isHeadshot=authoritativeHit.Name=="Head"
	local damage=c_damage.Value*(isHeadshot and 2 or 1)
	local applied=GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=hitPosition,IsCritical=isHeadshot,ShotToken=shotToken,RangedWeapon=true})
	if applied then
		if isHeadshot then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(hitPosition-root.Position).Unit) end
		GameHelper:SetNPCPoisoned(player,npc)
		GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
		if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.posionBowKill,1) end
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastAttackAt[player]=nil pendingShots[player]=nil end)

local Tool = script.Parent
local velocity = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("投掷力度").Value
local c_addBullet = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("恢复圣水数量")
local c_shotCD = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("发射间隔")

local v_bulletNum:IntValue = Tool.bulletNum
local v_bulletNumMax:IntValue = Tool.bulletNumMax
local v_lastAddBulletTime = Tool.lastAddBulletTime
local v_nextFireTime = Tool.nextFireTime
local v_addBulletCD = Tool.addBulletCD

local ThrowC2S = Tool.ThrowC2S

local AttackAble = true
local rand = 11.25

v_addBulletCD.Value = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("1级圣水恢复时长").Value

math.randomseed(tick())

function getPlayer()
	local char = Tool.Parent
	return game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
end

function Toss(startPosition:Vector3,direction:Vector3)
	local Object = Tool:FindFirstChild("圣水"):Clone()
	Object:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startPosition))
	Object.Transparency = 0
	Object.CanCollide = false
	Object.CanTouch = false
	Object.CanQuery = false
	Object.CFrame = Tool.Handle.CFrame
	Object.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (direction*velocity) + Vector3.new(0,velocity/7.5,0)
	Object.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-rand,rand),math.random(-rand,rand),math.random(-rand,rand))
	Object.Parent = workspace

	local player = getPlayer()
	local radius = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("1级圣水半径").Value
	local damage = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("1级圣水伤害").Value
	if player then
		if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PriestV2) then
			radius = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("2级圣水半径").Value
		end
		if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PriestV3) then
			damage = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("3级圣水伤害").Value
		end
	end
	
	-- 初始化数值

		--local hits = TouchPart:GetTouchingParts()
		--for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do

function Burn()

	Object.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))

local bow = script.Parent
local c_damage = bow:FindFirstChild("配置"):FindFirstChild("伤害")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local lastAttackAt = {}
local pendingShots = {}

local function validEquipped(player)
	return player.Character ~= nil and bow.Parent == player.Character and GameHelper:isAlive(player)
end
local function validVector(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
end
local function validToken(token)
	return type(token) == "number" and token % 1 == 0 and token >= 1 and token <= 2147483647
end
local function simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	local delta=endPos-startPos
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(startPos,delta.Unit*math.min(delta.Magnitude,1100),params)
	pendingShots[player]=pendingShots[player] or {}
	pendingShots[player][shotToken]={
		hit=result and result.Instance or nil,
		position=result and result.Position or nil,
		expires=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3,
		consumed=false,
	}
end

bow.Attack.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not validVector(startPos) or not validVector(endPos) then return end
	local firePoint = bow:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	if not firePoint or not firePoint:IsA("Attachment") or (startPos-firePoint.WorldPosition).Magnitude > 5 then return end
	local delta = endPos-startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 or delta.Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local previous=lastAttackAt[player] or 0
	if now-previous < 0.075 then return end
	lastAttackAt[player]=now
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local shots=pendingShots[player]
		local previousShot=shots and shots[shotToken]
		if previousShot and now<=previousShot.expires then return end
		simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	end
	bow.Attack:FireAllClients(startPos,endPos)
end)

bow.ArrowHitC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,hitPart,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not hitPart or not hitPart:IsA("BasePart") or not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	local authoritativeHit=hitPart
	local hitPosition=hitPart.Position
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local record=pendingShots[player] and pendingShots[player][shotToken]
		if not record or record.consumed or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>record.expires then return end
		record.consumed=true
		authoritativeHit=record.hit
		hitPosition=record.position
		if not authoritativeHit or not hitPosition then return end
		local _,clientNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hitPart)
		local _,serverNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
		if not clientNpc or clientNpc~=serverNpc then return end
	end
	local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (hitPosition-root.Position).Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
	if not isNpc or not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then return end
	local isHeadshot=authoritativeHit.Name=="Head"
	local damage=c_damage.Value*(isHeadshot and 2 or 1)
	local applied=GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=hitPosition,IsCritical=isHeadshot,ShotToken=shotToken,RangedWeapon=true})
	if applied then
		if isHeadshot then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(hitPosition-root.Position).Unit) end
		GameHelper:PlayerIceAttack(player,npc)
		GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
		if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.bowKill,1) end
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastAttackAt[player]=nil pendingShots[player]=nil end)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local RangedCombatClient = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("RangedCombatClient"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local CharacterValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CharacterValue
local featureSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版移动端射击视角")
local bow = script.Parent
local FirePoint = bow.Handle.FirePoint
local c_reloadTime = bow:FindFirstChild("配置"):FindFirstChild("装填时长")
local atkTrack:AnimationTrack?
local active = false

local function fireArrow(startPos:Vector3,endPos:Vector3,shotToken:number?)
	local isLocalPlayer = bow.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character
	bow:WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("Fire"):Play()
	local arrow = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("冰箭"):Clone()
	arrow.Position = startPos
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	arrow.Transparency = 1
	RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	arrow.Anchored = false
	game.Debris:AddItem(arrow,5)
	local delta = endPos - startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 then arrow:Destroy() return end
	arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = delta.Unit * 500
	local lastPos = arrow.Position
	while arrow and arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		if lastPos ~= arrow.Position then
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
			params:AddToFilter(arrow)
			local offset = arrow.Position - lastPos
			local hitResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset,params)
			if hitResult then
				local hit = hitResult.Instance
				if isLocalPlayer and GameHelper:IsNPC(hit) then
					bow.ArrowHitC2S:FireServer(hit,shotToken)
				end
				arrow:WaitForChild("Trail").Enabled = false
				local dir = arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.001 and arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit or offset.Unit
				arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position,hitResult.Position+dir)
				arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)
				break
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
		end
		RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	end
end

local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or bow:GetAttribute("Reload") or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		shotContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
		if not shotContext then return end
	end
	local endPos = shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
	bow:SetAttribute("Reload",true)
	bow.Arrow.Transparency = 1
	local reloadBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.bowReloadBonus)
	local reloadTime = GameHelper:CalculateCDDiminishing(c_reloadTime.Value,reloadBonus)
	task.delay(reloadTime,function()
		if bow.Parent then
			bow:SetAttribute("Reload",false)
			bow.Arrow.Transparency = 0
		end
	end)
	task.wait(0.1)
	if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local startPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
	bow.Attack:FireServer(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
	fireArrow(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)

	local doubleArrowBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.doubleArrowBonus)
	if math.random() <= doubleArrowBonus then
		if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
		task.delay(0.1,function()
			if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			local secondContext
			if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
				secondContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
				if not secondContext then return end
			end
			local secondEndPos = secondContext and secondContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
			local secondStartPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
			bow.Attack:FireServer(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
			fireArrow(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
		end)
	end
end

local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(bow)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(bow,shoot)
	end
end

bow:SetAttribute("Reload",false)
bow.Equipped:Connect(function()
	if bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	active = true
	atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character,109073254954663)
	atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
	atkTrack.Looped = false
	RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(bow)
	bindNewInput()
end)
bow.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	active = false
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(bow)
	if atkTrack then atkTrack:Destroy() atkTrack = nil end
end)
bow.Activated:Connect(function()
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then return end
	shoot(nil)
end)
featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(bindNewInput)
UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(bindNewInput)

bow.Attack.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(startPos:Vector3,endPos:Vector3)
	if bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then fireArrow(startPos,endPos) end
end)

local CollectionService=game:GetService("CollectionService")
local GameEnum=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ValueHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local AudioHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local UIHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local PlayerValue=ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerValue
local CharacterValue=ValueHelper.ValueModel.CharacterValue
local tool=script.Parent
local isFire=tool.Values.IsFire
local fireCount=tool:FindFirstChild("配置"):FindFirstChild("发射数量").Value
local bulletDamage=tool:FindFirstChild("配置"):FindFirstChild("每发子弹伤害").Value
local lastCharacter
local lastFireAt=0
local lastToken=nil
local burstPlayer=nil
local burstStarted=0
local burstNextIndex=1
local burstExpiresSerial=0

tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	local character=tool.Parent
	local player=game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if player and not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GatlinMasterV1) then lastCharacter=character ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"装备加特林",-4) end
end)
tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	if lastCharacter and lastCharacter:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(lastCharacter,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"装备加特林",0) end
	isFire.Value=false
end)
local function finite(v) return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and v.X==v.X and v.Y==v.Y and v.Z==v.Z end
tool.TryFire.OnServerInvoke=function(player,claimedHit,endPos,shotToken,burstIndex)
	if tool.Parent~=player.Character or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or not finite(endPos) then return false end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local indexedBurst=type(shotToken)=="number" and type(burstIndex)=="number"
	if indexedBurst then
		if burstIndex%1~=0 or burstIndex<1 or burstIndex>fireCount then return false end
		if shotToken~=lastToken or burstPlayer~=player or now-burstStarted>2 then
			if burstIndex~=1 or isFire.Value or now-lastFireAt<0.15 then return false end
			lastToken=shotToken burstPlayer=player burstStarted=now burstNextIndex=1 lastFireAt=now isFire.Value=true
			burstExpiresSerial+=1
			local expirySerial=burstExpiresSerial
			task.delay(math.max(1.5,fireCount*0.1+0.5),function()
				if burstExpiresSerial==expirySerial and isFire.Value then isFire.Value=false end
			end)
		end
		if burstIndex~=burstNextIndex then return false end
		burstNextIndex+=1
	else
		if isFire.Value or now-lastFireAt<0.15 then return false end
		lastToken=shotToken burstPlayer=player burstStarted=now burstNextIndex=fireCount+1 lastFireAt=now isFire.Value=true
	end

	local function fireOne(requestedEnd:Vector3,currentToken:number?)
		if tool.Parent~=player.Character or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or not finite(requestedEnd) then return false end
		local origin=tool.Main.Position
		local delta=requestedEnd-origin
		if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 or delta.Magnitude>110 then return false end
		local bullets=ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.GatlinBullet)
		if not bullets or bullets.Value<=0 then
			AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"Empty Gun Sound")
			UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"Insufficient ammunition!",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
			return false
		end
		local params=RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
		params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
		local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,delta.Unit*100,params)
		local hit=result and result.Instance or nil
		local actualEnd=result and result.Position or origin+delta.Unit*100
		local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
		local cost=1
		if isNpc and player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GatlinMasterV2) and math.random()<=0.1 then cost=0 end
		bullets.Value-=cost
		if isNpc then
			local critical=hit.Name=="Head"
			local damage=bulletDamage*(critical and 2 or 1)
			local wasAlive=GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc)
			if GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=actualEnd,IsCritical=critical,ShotToken=currentToken,RangedWeapon=true}) then
				if critical then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(actualEnd-player.Character:GetPivot().Position).Unit) end
				if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GatlinMasterV3) and math.random()<=0.1 then GameHelper:SetNPCBurning(player,npc) end
				GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
				if wasAlive and not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then
					GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.gatlinKill,1)
				end
			end
		end
		tool.FireS2C:FireAllClients(hit,actualEnd)
		return true,bullets.Value
	end

	if indexedBurst then
		local accepted,remaining=fireOne(endPos,shotToken)
		if not accepted or burstIndex>=fireCount or remaining<=0 then isFire.Value=false end
		return accepted
	end

	local legacyEnd=endPos
	task.spawn(function()
		for _=1,fireCount do
			if not isFire.Value or tool.Parent~=player.Character then break end
			local accepted,remaining=fireOne(legacyEnd,nil)
			if not accepted or remaining<=0 then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		isFire.Value=false
	end)
	return true
end
